verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say it can pay employees and contractors in a single system ([rippling-docs-16], [rippling-docs-39]). It also automatically calculates and files payroll taxes with US federal, state, and local agencies ([rippling-docs-44]), which covers the core of paying both worker types from one platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 1099 contractor payments and 1099/W-2 form generation, and independent or hands-on confirmation of contractor payouts alongside W-2 payroll.
